```
{r}
make_segment <- function(n) {
  x <- seq(n, n + 1, length.out = 200)
  x <- x[x < (n + 1)]
  data.frame(x = x, y = x - n)
}

df <- rbind(
  make_segment(0),
  data.frame(x = NA, y = NA),
  make_segment(1),
  data.frame(x = NA, y = NA),
  make_segment(2)
)

closed_pts <- data.frame(x = 0:3, y = 0)
open_pts   <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = 1)

rational_part_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1, color = "blue") +   # <-- KEY CHANGE
  
  geom_point(data = closed_pts,
             size = 3, shape = 16, color = "blue") +
  
  geom_point(data = open_pts,
             size = 3, shape = 1, stroke = 1, color = "blue") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:3) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "$\\alpha$",
    y = "$\\{\\alpha\\} = \\alpha - \\lfloor \\alpha\\rfloor$"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

myggsave(rational_part_plot, width = 6, height = 4)

```
```
{r}
create_data <- function(alpha, m){
res <- rSPDE:::interp_rational_coefficients(
  order = m, 
  type_rational_approx = "brasil", 
  type_interp = "spline", 
  alpha = alpha)

partFraction <- function(x) {
  term_matrix <- outer(x, res$p, "-") # matrix of (x - p[i])
  term_values <- sweep(1 / term_matrix, 2, res$r, "*") # multiply columns by r[i]
  return(rowSums(term_values) + res$k)
}

powerFun <- function(x){
  return(x^(-(alpha-floor(alpha))))
}

delta <- 10^(-(5+m)/2)

x_to_compute_error <- seq(1, 1/delta, length.out = 1000)
x <- seq(1, min_reciprocal_delta, length.out = 1000)
pf <- partFraction(x)
po <- powerFun(x)
Linferror <- max(abs(partFraction(x_to_compute_error) - powerFun(x_to_compute_error)))
df <- rbind(data.frame(x = x, val = pf, method = "partFraction", alpha = alpha, m = m, Linferror = Linferror),
            data.frame(x = x, val =  po, method = "powerFun", alpha = alpha, m = m, Linferror = Linferror))
return(df)
}

alpha <- c(0.4, 1.6, 2.4)
m <- c(2,6,12)
delta_aux <- 10^(-(5+m)/2)
min_reciprocal_delta <- min(1/delta_aux)
min_m <- min(m)

df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(alpha, function(a) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(m, function(mm) {
    create_data(a, mm)
  }))
}))


df <- df |>
  mutate(
    m = {
      m_vals <- sort(unique(m))
      factor(
        m,
        levels = m_vals,
        labels = sprintf("$m = %g$", m_vals))
      },
    alpha = {
      alpha_vals <- sort(unique(alpha))
      factor(
        alpha,
        levels = alpha_vals,
        labels = sprintf("$\\alpha = %g$", alpha_vals)
      )
    },
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c("partFraction", "powerFun")[2:1],
      labels = c("$r_m(x^{-1}) = kx^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}+x^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}\\sum_{i=1}^mr_i(x-p_i)^{-1}$", "$f(x^{-1}) = x^{-\\alpha}$")[2:1]
    )
  )


format_scientific <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  ifelse(
    x == 0,
    "0",
    {
      e <- floor(log10(abs(x)))
      m <- round(x / 10^e, digits)
      sprintf("%.2f \\times 10^{%d}", m, e)
    }
  )
}

df_lab <- df |>
  group_by(m, alpha) |>
  summarise(
    Linferror = first(Linferror),
    x_mid = mean(range(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    y_mid = exp(mean(log(range(val, na.rm = TRUE)))),  # because of log scale
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_RAT1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x, val, color = method, linetype = method)) + 
  facet_grid(m ~ alpha) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  scale_y_log10(n.breaks = 5) +
  scale_x_log10(n.breaks = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Function", values = c("$r_m(x^{-1}) = kx^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}+x^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}\\sum_{i=1}^mr_i(x-p_i)^{-1}$" = "red", "$f(x^{-1}) = x^{-\\alpha}$" = "blue")) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Function", values = c("$r_m(x^{-1}) = kx^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}+x^{-\\lfloor\\alpha\\rfloor}\\sum_{i=1}^mr_i(x-p_i)^{-1}$" = "dashed", "$f(x^{-1}) = x^{-\\alpha}$" = "solid")[2:1]) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),  # alpha (top)
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),   # m (left)
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),  # x-axis numbers
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),   # y-axis numbers
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        #plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = sprintf("$x\\in[1,1/\\delta_{%d}]\\quad(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$", min_m),
       y = "$(\\log_{10}\\mbox{ scale})$" # $r_m(x^{-1}),\\;f(x^{-1})$"
       ) + 
  theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.key.width  = unit(2, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0, "cm")
) +
 geom_text(
    data = df_lab,
    aes(
      #label = sprintf("$\\|f-r_m\\|_{L_{\\infty}([1,1/\\delta_{%d}])} = %s$", min_m, format_scientific(Linferror))
      label = sprintf("$\\|f-r_m\\|_{L_{\\infty}([1,1/\\delta_m])} = %s$", format_scientific(Linferror))
    ),
    x = 0,
    y = -2.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    parse = FALSE,
    size = 3.5,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0
  ) 


myggsave(p_RAT1, width = 9, height = 6)

```

```{r, eval = TRUE, out.width="1200px", out.height="600px", fig.cap = captioner("Covariance error for the interval graph.")}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("data_files/tikzpic/p_RAT1.pdf"))
```

```
partFraction <- function(x) {
  term_matrix <- outer(x, res$p, "-") # matrix of (x - p[i])
```

```{r}
alpha_vector <- 0.4 + seq(0.1, 0.5, by = 0.05) + 2
m_vector <- c(1:14)
errors <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(m_vector), ncol = length(alpha_vector))
for (alpha in alpha_vector) {
  for (m in m_vector) {
    res <- rSPDE:::interp_rational_coefficients(
      order = m, 
      type_rational_approx = "brasil", 
      type_interp = "spline", 
      alpha = alpha)
    
    partFraction <- function(x) {
      term_matrix <- outer(x, res$p, "-") # matrix of (x - p[i])
      term_values <- sweep(1 / term_matrix, 2, res$r, "*") # multiply columns by r[i]
      return(rowSums(term_values) + res$k)
    }
    
    powerFun <- function(x){
      return(x^(-(alpha-floor(alpha))))
    }
    
    delta <- 10^(-(5+m)/2)
    x <- seq(1, 1/delta, length.out = 10)
    pf <- partFraction(x)
    po <- powerFun(x)
    Linferror <- max(abs(pf - po))
    
    m_index <- which(m_vector == m)
    alpha_index <- which(alpha_vector == alpha)
    errors[m_index, alpha_index] <- Linferror
  }
}

observed_rates <- rep(NA, length(alpha_vector))
for (u in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  observed_rates[u] <- coef(lm(log(errors[, u]) ~ sqrt(m_vector)))[2]
}

theoretical_rates <- - 2 * pi * sqrt(alpha_vector - floor(alpha_vector))

conv_rate_ratapprox <- error.convergence.plotter(x_axis_vector = m_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector = alpha_vector - floor(alpha_vector), 
                                 errors, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = exp_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = "",
                                 x_axis_label = "$m\\quad(\\sqrt{\\phantom{x}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 y_axis_label = "$\\|f-r_m\\|_{L_{\\infty}([1,1/\\delta_m])}\\quad(\\log_{\\mathrm{e}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 color_label = "$\\quad\\;\\;\\{\\alpha\\}\\;|\\;\\;\\mbox{theo}\\;|\\;\\;\\mbox{obs}\\;\\;\\;|\\%\\mbox{re}$",
                                 apply_sqrt = TRUE)

myggsave(conv_rate_ratapprox, width = 8, height = 3.2)

```






```{r, eval = TRUE, out.width="1000px", out.height="400px", fig.cap = captioner("Covariance error for the interval graph.")}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("data_files/tikzpic/conv_rate_ratapprox.pdf"))
```

# Compare true eigenvalues with that of the matrix

```
{r}
kappa <- 4

h = 0.09
graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = h)
graph$compute_fem()


H <- h/2
GRAPH <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = H)
GRAPH$compute_fem()

C <- GRAPH$mesh$C
G <- GRAPH$mesh$G
L <- kappa^2*C + G
realL <- L %*% solve(C) / kappa^2
EIGEN <- Re(rev(eigen(realL, only.values = TRUE)$values))


C <- graph$mesh$C
G <- graph$mesh$G
L <- kappa^2*C + G
realL <- L %*% solve(C) / kappa^2
eigenval <- Re(rev(eigen(realL, only.values = TRUE)$values))



N_finite <- 2/3 * (length(eigenval) - 1) + 1
eigenpairs <- gets.eigen.params(N_finite = N_finite, kappa = kappa, alpha = 0.8, graph)
EIGENVAL <- eigenpairs$EIGENVAL / kappa^2


df <- data.frame(
  index = 1:length(eigenval),
  eigenval = eigenval,
  EIGEN = EIGEN[1:length(eigenval)],
  EIGENVAL = EIGENVAL[1:length(eigenval)]
) 

p_eigen <- ggplot(df, aes(x = index)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = eigenval, color = "$\\lambda_{j,h}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = eigenval, color = "$\\lambda_{j,h}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EIGEN, color = "$\\lambda_{j,H}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = EIGEN, color = "$\\lambda_{j,H}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EIGENVAL, color = "$\\lambda_{j}\\mbox{ (true)}$"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = EIGENVAL, color = "$\\lambda_{j}\\mbox{ (true)}$"), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Eigenvalues", values = c("$\\lambda_{j,h}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$" = "green", 
                                                      "$\\lambda_{j,H}\\mbox{ (numerical)}$" = "red", 
                                                      "$\\lambda_{j}\\mbox{ (true)}$" = "blue")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "$j$", 
       y = "$\\lambda_j,\\;\\lambda_{j,h},\\;\\lambda_{j,H}$") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0, "cm"))



myggsave(p_eigen, width = 8, height = 4)
```

```
{r}
compute_lower_bound <- function(h){
kappa <- 4
graph <- gets.graph.tadpole(h = h)
graph$compute_fem()
C <- graph$mesh$C
G <- graph$mesh$G
L <- kappa^2*C + G
I <- diag(nrow(C))
realL <- L %*% solve(C, I) / kappa^2
lambda_max <- Re(RSpectra::eigs(realL, k = 1, which = "LM")$values)
cte <- 1/lambda_max
return(cte)
}


h_vector <- seq(0.005, 0.1, by = 0.005)
lower_bounds <- sapply(h_vector, compute_lower_bound)
df_lower <- data.frame(h = h_vector, lower_bound = lower_bounds)

p_lower <- ggplot(df_lower, aes(x = h, y = lower_bound)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  scale_y_log10(n.breaks = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "$h$", 
       y = "$\\kappa^2\\lambda^{-1}_{N_h,h}$")
myggsave(p_lower, width = 8, height = 4)
```
